[[File:YodaDagobahLight.png|thumb|250px|Qui-Gon Jinn appears to Yoda in the form of fireflies.]]
'''Fireflies''' were flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]].

[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] once appeared to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the form of fireflies, explaining to him that he had not completed his training to properly appear as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] and therefore was unable to appear as anything more.

[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] used the name of this fly as a slang word for the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[AirStraeker]].
